card.name: Initiate supportive treatment after discontinuing
card.fires_on: The word "initiate" (once "institution of") right after "discontinue [drug] and", just before "supportive" or "symptomatic treatment". It appears in serotonin syndrome warnings.

modes.label: Initiate after discontinue
modes.description: "initiate" follows "discontinue the drug and" and leads into supportive treatment.
modes.example: If such symptoms occur, discontinue desvenlafaxine and<< initiate>> supportive treatment.

modes.label: Institution of
modes.description: "of" in "institution of" before symptomatic and supportive therapy in overdosage text.
modes.example: The treatment of overdosage consists of discontinuation of Karbinal ER and institution<< of>> symptomatic and supportive therapy.
